name: Alilph Skeda
source:
The leader of Skeda's Skivs, a band of mercenaries and pirates living on a volcanic planet Aretine.

Skeda is personally responsible for the botched attempt on rival captain [url=/c173790]Xile[/url]'s life, resulting in the bounty on his head.
